verdict.rationale: Folk documents custom fields for adding information to people and companies inside a group, and offers AI-generated custom fields, so the custom-field half of the story is covered. There is no evidence of filtered, sorted, or shared views, or that ops users can do this without admin involvement. Missing for 10: documented filtered/sorted views, shared views, evidence that non-admin users can self-serve these changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
